leakage.removal_reason: Assigned post-creation (not available at triage time); corr=0.595 with log(resolution_hours), fills 6.9% on fast issues vs 93.1% on slow — pure leakage.

prior_metrics_invalidated.note: These metrics were computed on a broken closed_at temporal split where test issues were closed before some train issues were created. Retracted. See ADR-0009.

vscode.note: LightGBM underperforms naive on vscode because there is no creation-time signal that predicts resolution time for this repo. The system detects this at the repo level (bucket model improvement −70.5% vs naive) and surfaces a badge to the user rather than presenting a prediction that is worse than the baseline. See /eval for full methodology.

calibration.method: temperature scaling (sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV not used — custom T_opt applied to raw logit scores)
calibration.isotonic_note: Isotonic calibration tested (vscode test ECE 0.072, k8s 0.026) but not shipped — accuracy CIs overlapped zero and temperature scaling is simpler/more interpretable.

judge.cross_family_rationale: Not one model grading its own homework — Cohere Command A is a different model family from the Groq/Meta LLaMA triage model.

cross_family_validation.decision: Llama-70b retained as default judge — gap is -3.6pp, below the 5pp escalation threshold. High ranking agreement (r=0.729) confirms cross-family result is not an outlier.

reranker.phase1_verdict: Mixed — k8s gain, vscode regression. Proceeded to robustness test.
reranker.phase2_verdict: CI crosses zero — the Phase 1 +6pp k8s result was a false positive at n=100. Reranker rejected. BGE FAISS k=20 baseline shipped.
reranker.slates_note: 8 cross-encoder candidates across 2 slates (general-purpose + duplicate/STS models); all failed or showed mixed/negative results before bge-v2-m3 robustness test.

conformal.caveats: Marginal (not conditional) coverage; assumes exchangeability. vscode train(2015-16)/test(2026, 7-day window) violates this — report empirical coverage, not theoretical guarantee.

microsoft/vscode.calibration_split: 40/60 of test (246 cal / 370 true-test); 30/70 (68.3%) also computed — 5.8pp divergence reported in ADR-0010 as temporal non-stationarity finding
microsoft/vscode.exchangeability_note: train 2015-10-13..2016-04-05, test 2026-04-21..2026-04-27 (7-day window). Temporal regime gap violates exchangeability; 74.1% empirical coverage vs 80% target is the honest outcome.
